title: Cannes 2023
deck: An invitation to Cannes, drawn in blue line.
lede: For HollyShorts' events at the 2023 Cannes Film Festival, the invitation was a drawing: the coast in a fine blue line, and above the details, “Tu es invité.”
challenge: In May 2023, the Oscar-qualifying HollyShorts Film Festival hosted events at the Cannes Film Festival. They needed original artwork and an invitation.
work: The invitation is drawn rather than photographed: a light blue line of the coast, like a sketch on hotel stationery, with the event details set below. It is written in French, for a festival in France, and continues on the back.
credits: Dalton Corr: original artwork and invitation design
